title: Dual voltage-controlled oscillator with enable and range inputs

sources.document: TI SN54LS624 thru SN54LS629, SN74LS624 thru SN74LS629 voltage-controlled oscillators datasheet SDLS186 (January 1980, revised March 1988)

pins.name: 1EN
pins.text: enable: low = output enabled; high = oscillator stopped and 1Y high

pins.name: OSCGND
pins.text: separate ground for the oscillators (OSC GND)

pins.name: GND
pins.text: ground for the enable, synchronization-gating and output sections

pins.name: 2EN
pins.text: enable: low = output enabled; high = oscillator stopped and 2Y high

pins.name: OSCVCC
pins.text: separate supply for the oscillators and frequency-control circuits (OSC VCC)

pins.name: VCC
pins.text: supply for the enable, synchronization-gating and output sections

functions.text: While 1EN is low, 1Y is a square wave (about 50 percent duty) at the frequency set by the capacitor and the 1FC and 1RNG voltages; while 1EN is high the oscillator is stopped and 1Y is high.
While 2EN is low, 2Y is a square wave (about 50 percent duty) at the frequency set by the capacitor and the 2FC and 2RNG voltages; while 2EN is high the oscillator is stopped and 2Y is high.

electrical.notes: SN74LS629 figures (page 6). Output frequency 1 Hz to 20 MHz (recommended). Frequency-control and range inputs take 0-5 V and draw 50/250 uA typ/max at 5 V. Above 10 MHz two separate supplies are recommended; the two VCOs can disturb each other when both run (page 1).

timingLimits.text: Cext 50 pF, V(freq) 5 V, V(rng) 0 V: 15/20/25 MHz min/typ/max; V(freq) 1 V, V(rng) 5 V: 1.1/1.6/2.1 MHz (page 7, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF)

unknown: No propagation delay from EN to Y is given in the datasheet.
The exact frequency for a given capacitor and control voltages is given only as typical curves (figures 1-3, pages 7-8).
notes: The oscillator itself is analog; behaviour models its square wave as the condition OSC1/OSC2. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS629.

behaviour.source: pages 1, 3, 4 - TI SN54LS624 thru SN54LS629, SN74LS624 thru SN74LS629 voltage-controlled oscillators datasheet SDLS186 (January 1980, revised March 1988)

conditions.name: OSC1
conditions.meaning: the square wave of oscillator 1: frequency set by the capacitor on 1CX1-1CX2 and the voltages on 1FC and 1RNG (figures 1-3), 1 Hz to 20 MHz, duty about 50 percent; a synchronizing gate makes the first pulse after enable neither clipped nor extended
conditions.source: pages 1, 3, 4 - TI SN54LS624 thru SN54LS629, SN74LS624 thru SN74LS629 voltage-controlled oscillators datasheet SDLS186 (January 1980, revised March 1988) (description)

conditions.name: OSC2
conditions.meaning: the square wave of oscillator 2: frequency set by the capacitor on 2CX1-2CX2 and the voltages on 2FC and 2RNG (figures 1-3), 1 Hz to 20 MHz, duty about 50 percent; a synchronizing gate makes the first pulse after enable neither clipped nor extended
